entry.summary:
Watch Phylesha Brown-Acton talk about how adornment influences her life as a Niuean woman, and the Western trope of Pacific women being perceived and portrayed as anonymous exotic dusky maidens.

The subtitles are available in English, te reo Māori and Niuean. As YouTube doesn't have the Niuean language listed, the Niuean subtitles are listed as Tongan.
